ICN.description: Ingest Connector - Configuration and lifecycle of one ingest source.

KIND.description: Transport or source shape used by this connector.

STATUS.description: Connector lifecycle state, independent of any `$STF` listing status.

STATUS_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable detail about the current status.

ENDPOINT_URL.description: HTTPS endpoint from which records are pulled.

HTTP_METHOD.description: HTTP method used for an endpoint request.

AUTH_KIND.description: Authentication shape used for an endpoint request.

AUTH_HEADER_NAME.description: Header name used when AUTH_KIND is ApiKeyHeader.

CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE.description:
Credential-store key resolved only at execution time. A secret never
appears in an ICN record.

POLL_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval in milliseconds between endpoint polls.

DIRECTORY_PATH.description: Directory scanned by a filesystem-watch connector.

SCAN_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval in milliseconds between directory scans.

SETTLE_DELAY_MS.description: Minimum unchanged time in milliseconds before a file is ingested.

POST_INGEST_ACTION.description: Disposition of a source file after verified ingest.

UPLOAD_SESSION_ID.description: Identifier of the bounded upload session.

UPLOAD_FILE_COUNT.description: Number of files accepted into the upload session.

UPLOAD_TOTAL_BYTES.description: Total uploaded byte count across all session files.

UPLOAD_CONTENT_HASH.description: Content hash covering the uploaded session payload.

DETECTED_FORMAT.description: Detected source serialization or container format.

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records detected in the validation sample.

LAST_INGEST_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last successful ingest.

LAST_ERROR_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last ingest error.

LAST_ERROR.description: Human-readable detail about the last ingest error.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this connector was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this connector was last updated.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the provider that issued this connector record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the connector record.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the connector retrieves records from, as a host name
or stable identifier.

ORIGIN_NAME.description: Display name of the upstream publisher.

DATASET_ID.description: Stable dataset identifier within the origin, e.g. "gp-full-catalog".

PROVIDER_ID.description: Provider identifier the lane's records are stored under.

SOURCE_NAME.description: Source name the lane's records are stored under.

LICENSE.description: Licence under which the upstream publisher offers the records.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

MIN_FETCH_INTERVAL_MS.description: Minimum interval between fetches of the same dataset, milliseconds.

NEXT_ELIGIBLE_AT.description: Unix milliseconds when the next fetch is eligible.

LAST_HTTP_STATUS.description: HTTP status of the last fetch.

LAST_SOURCE_ETAG.description: Entity tag returned by the last fetch.

LAST_SOURCE_LAST_MODIFIED.description: Last-Modified value returned by the last fetch.

LAST_BATCH_ID.description: Batch identifier of the last ingest.

LAST_RECORD_COUNT.description: Records parsed by the last ingest.

LAST_INSERTED_COUNT.description: Records newly inserted by the last ingest.

LAST_DURATION_MS.description: Duration of the last fetch and ingest, milliseconds.

FETCH_COUNT.description: Fetches attempted over the connector's lifetime.

INGEST_COUNT.description: Ingests completed over the connector's lifetime.

LAST_PUBLICATION_CID.description: Content identifier of the last publication manifest emitted.

LAST_PNM_CID.description: Content identifier of the last publish notification emitted.

FEED_HEAD.description: Feed head the connector last advanced to.

EMITS_SCHEMAS.description: Standard codes the connector emits, e.g. ["OMM", "MPE"].

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

GrantFieldStreamPolicy.description: Field-level stream policy bound into protected delivery and grants.

ProtectedDeliveryBinding.description: Immutable encrypted artifact/window metadata for protected delivery.

ProviderReputation.description: Provider reputation summary surfaced in marketplace listings.

OBJECT_IDS.description: Specific NORAD IDs or catalog numbers

MIN_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Minimum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

MAX_ALTITUDE_KM.description: Maximum altitude in kilometers for altitude-bounded offerings

GEO_BOUNDS.description: Bounding box as [min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon]

DataCoverage.description: Data coverage combining spatial and temporal

PRICE_AMOUNT.description: Price in smallest unit (cents, satoshis, etc.)

RATE_LIMIT.description: Rate limit in requests per hour

FEATURES.description: List of features included in this tier

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the data provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

DESCRIPTION.description: Detailed description of the data offering

ENCRYPTION_REQUIRED.description: Whether encryption is required for data delivery

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when listing was last updated

ACTIVE.description: Whether the listing is currently active

LISTING_KIND.description: Listing category: data stream or WASM module

SAMPLE_RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of records in sample data, when available

PROTECTED_DELIVERY.description: Protected delivery metadata for encrypted artifacts or streams

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the listing expires, or 0 for no expiry

SOURCE_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID this listing was sourced from when discovered remotely

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this listing belongs to, for browse,
filter and per-category counting. A listing MAY carry several. If
nonempty it MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

RECOMMENDED_RETENTION.description:
Retention rule the publisher recommends to subscribers of a dataset
listing: ReplaceCurrent when each publication is a complete current set,
KeepAll when publications accumulate history the store should keep,
ArchiveAll when that history should also stay pinned.

SRGProvider.description: One data provider: a publisher a retriever may fetch from.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the provider within the registry, lower-case, e.g.
"spacex-starlink", "iss", "gps-precise".

OPERATOR.description: Organization that operates the provider, e.g. "NASA", "SES S.A.".

FORMAT.description:
Default format of the provider's resources, as a format token the
retriever and its parsers agree on, e.g. "ccsds-oem-kvn", "sp3-gzip",
"tle". A resource may state its own FORMAT. Containers with an SDS
format class are named by $NCD's container format.

ORIGINS.description:
Origins (scheme, host and optional port, no path, e.g.
"https://api.starlink.com") every resource URL of this provider must
start with. A URL outside these is refused. Empty = none allowed.

REFRESH_INTERVAL_S.description:
Interval at which the provider publishes new data, and so the shortest
useful interval between discoveries, seconds; 0 = not stated.

CREDENTIALED.description:
True when retrieval needs credentials (an account, a token or a key).
The registry never carries the credentials themselves.

DESCRIPTION.description: Short description of what the provider publishes.

INFO_URL.description: Home page or documentation of the provider's data.

LICENSE.description: Licence under which the provider offers the data, and its URL.

CONNECTOR.description:
The provider as configured as an ingest source on a node, when it is:
lifecycle, credential reference, polling and last-fetch figures.

SRGResource.description:
One retrievable resource of a provider: a file or an endpoint that
returns one document.

SOURCE_ID.description: SOURCE_ID of the provider the resource belongs to.

RESOURCE_ID.description:
Identifier of the resource within its provider, stable across
discoveries (normally the file name), e.g. "ISS.OEM_J2K_EPH.txt".

URL.description:
Absolute URL the resource is fetched from; it lies inside one of the
provider's ORIGINS. Never carries credentials.

FORMAT.description: Format token of the resource; empty = the provider's FORMAT.

COVERAGE.description:
What the resource covers (objects, regions, time span), when the
provider states it or discovery can tell; absent = not known.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Size of the resource in bytes when the listing states it; 0 = unknown.

MODIFIED_AT_MS.description:
Unix milliseconds the provider last modified the resource, when the
listing states it; 0 = unknown.

DISCOVERED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the resource was discovered; 0 = unknown.

SRGContentReceipt.description:
Receipt from a content-addressed store (IPFS or similar) for bytes it
stored.

CID.description: Content identifier the store assigned (a CID), e.g. "bafy...".

NAME.description: Name the store recorded with the content, if any.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Address of the content, e.g. "/ipfs/<CID>"; empty = derive from CID.

SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex; empty = not computed.

PINNED.description: True when the store pinned the content (keeps it from eviction).

STORED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the content was stored; 0 = not reported.

STORE_ID.description: Store that issued the receipt, e.g. "ipfs", or a node identifier.

RESOURCE_ID.description:
RESOURCE_ID of the resource the bytes came from, when they came from
one; empty for other content (e.g. a pinned discovery queue).

SRGRetrievalSettings.description:
Limits and choices a retriever runs under. A field left 0 or empty takes
the retriever's default.

ENABLED.description: True to retrieve on schedule; false leaves the retriever idle.

SOURCE_ID.description: SOURCE_ID of the provider to retrieve from.

MAX_RESOURCES.description: Resources fetched per run at most.

MAX_BYTES.description:
Largest single resource accepted, bytes; a larger one is refused, never
truncated.

TIMEOUT_MS.description: Time allowed for one request, milliseconds.

MAX_RUNTIME_MS.description: Time allowed for one run, milliseconds.

REFRESH_INTERVAL_S.description:
Interval between discoveries, seconds (overrides the provider's
REFRESH_INTERVAL_S).

ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES.description: Total bytes the retriever may store over its lifetime.

CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE.description:
Key of the credential in the host's credential store, resolved only at
retrieval time (as $ICN CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE). Never the secret itself.

PATHS.description:
Provider API paths to read, for providers that expose several (absolute
paths without query strings, e.g. "/v2/ephemeris").

EPOCH_MS.description:
Unix milliseconds of the retrieval epoch (selects dated products, e.g.
the GPS week); 0 = now.

SRGRetrievalStatus.description: Progress of a retriever through a provider's resources.

ENABLED.description: True when retrieval is turned on.

GENERATED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds of this status; 0 = not stated.

RETRIEVED_COUNT.description: Resources fetched in the run that produced this status.

COMPLETED_COUNT.description: Resources of the current discovery queue processed so far.

TOTAL_COUNT.description: Resources in the current discovery queue; 0 = no queue or unknown.

QUEUE_CID.description:
CID of the stored discovery queue (an SRG with RESOURCES) the retriever
works through; empty = none.

ARCHIVE_RESERVED_BYTES.description: Bytes stored (or reserved) against ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES so far.

ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES.description: The storage budget, bytes; 0 = unlimited or not stated.

NORMALIZED_RECORDS.description:
Normalized SDS records produced from the retrieved resources (raw
preservation produces none).

RESOURCE_URL.description:
The resource the status concerns, when it concerns one (e.g. a
ProviderPageOnly answer): its URL, size and SHA-256 (lower-case hex).

SCANNED_COUNT.description:
For a paged pass over stored resources (rebuilding coverage from
archived descriptors): items scanned in this page, items of a supported
format among them, and the offset the next page starts at. STATE is
Complete on the last page.

SRG.description:
Data Source Registry - providers, their resources, storage receipts and
retrieval progress.

REGISTRY_ID.description:
Identifier of the registry, e.g. a repository name or a node's registry
name; empty = not named.

UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY.description:
Where the registry's provider list comes from, when it mirrors an
upstream list: the repository URL, the revision mirrored and the path of
the list inside it.

GENERATED_AT_MS.description:
Unix milliseconds this record was generated (for a discovery queue, the
time of discovery); 0 = not stated.

RESOURCES.description: Resources, in retrieval order. A single job carries one.
